facts.fact: FuturAfric Intelligence Artificielle launched the AI-based YIRI social and e-commerce platform in Abidjan, with six local languages covered, Baoulé and Dioula at 70% progress, and a locally hosted corpus of about 50,000 translated sentences and 300 annotated audio files, per the promoters (Linfodrome).

systems.platform: AI social and e-commerce platform in local languages
